name: glyph
description: A local-first terminal coding agent with ChatGPT authentication and reviewable workspace edits.

scripts.start: pnpm context-index:build && pnpm shell-sandbox:build && node --import tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env src/cli.ts
scripts.desktop:artifact: pnpm build && pnpm context-index:build && pnpm shell-sandbox:build && node scripts/build-desktop-artifact.mjs
scripts.code-oss:compile: pnpm code-oss:check:ui && pnpm code-oss:apply && pnpm code-oss:check:overlay && node scripts/code-oss/run.mjs run compile-client
scripts.context-index:check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --package glyph-context-index --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm context-index:check && pnpm shell-sandbox:check && pnpm context-index:build && pnpm shell-sandbox:build && tsc --noEmit && pnpm code-oss:check:ui && pnpm code-oss:check:storybook && pnpm build
scripts.test: pnpm context-index:test && pnpm shell-sandbox:test && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm context-index:build && pnpm shell-sandbox:build && vitest run --pool=forks --maxWorkers=1 src/application/tests/EditingLoop.e2e.test.ts src/application/tests/ContextInjection.e2e.test.ts src/context/search/tests/RustWorkspacePathIndex.e2e.test.ts src/project/tests/MultiRootProjectAccess.e2e.test.ts src/terminal/tests/TerminalEditing.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:transform-performance: for size in 1 5 10 20 50; do node --expose-gc --import tsx src/editing/documents/test/TextEditTransformer.benchmark.ts $size; done
